breakpoints.usage: Mobile first. Layouts switch to the desktop design at this width. CSS media queries can't read custom properties, so stylesheets repeat this value as `@media (min-width: 960px)`.

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Page ground on every page except blog posts. Also small labels and ring lines on plum and slate.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Text on plum and slate slabs, the reading ground of blog posts, form fields and placeholder pills.

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: Primary text on peach and cream, and the big dark slabs (hero, edition block, 'The competition' card).

tokens.name: plum-deep
tokens.usage: Text on coral, dusty pink and edition fills (on-accent), and the ground inside the edition cover frame.

tokens.name: plum-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on peach and cream: footnotes, the UN disclaimer, captions. Passes 4.5:1 on both.

tokens.name: plum-rule
tokens.usage: Connector lines on plum slabs. Decorative only, never text.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Second slab colour (SDG panel, waitlist arch, partner band). Cream or peach text on top.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Fill only: primary buttons, the quote cap, nav underline on plum. Text on top is plum-deep. Never text on cream or peach.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Dusty pink. Fill only: 'The blog' card, the 'What they do' panel, rings on plum. Text on top is plum-deep. Never text on cream or peach.

tokens.name: sea
tokens.usage: Deep sea blue from the lighthouse images. Use sparingly, as rings beside those images and as a card fill. Not a text colour on peach.

tokens.name: sea-light
tokens.usage: Light sea blue from the lighthouse images. Use sparingly, as a card fill with plum on top.

tokens.name: field-hint
tokens.usage: Placeholder text inside cream form fields only. Passes 4.5:1 on cream.

tokens.name: edition
tokens.usage: The current edition's SDG colour. Inaugural edition = SDG 2 mustard. The only token that changes between editions. Used for the cover's egg yolk and the 'Now' goal on About, never for text. plum-deep text on top.

mosaic.usage: Tile colours for the edition cover mosaic, dark to light: the brand palette plus in-between shades so tones blend. 'edition' in edition-ramp is replaced by the edition token.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Big problems. Young writers. One goal at a time.
styles.usage: Page titles in the hero slab.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Headlines of feature sections: 'A light for strangers.', the edition hook.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: Card titles and the goals list.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Pharos is an essay competition for students, with a Junior and an Open category.
styles.usage: The plain-text line that repeats what the hero says.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: We're student volunteers who think young people should have a say.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: One SDG per edition, judged anonymously by humans.
styles.usage: Card text, footer, notes. Never smaller than 16px.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small labels above headings. Sentence case, never tracked-out capitals.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The site name in the header. Decorative accent only: never body text or essential information.

styles.name: wordmark-xl
styles.usage: The closing wordmark in the footer. Decorative, hidden from screen readers.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Page side margin and slab padding.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a component.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between text blocks in a section.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space between sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space between sections on desktop. Generous empty space is part of the look.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Placeholder cards and the bottom of blog cards.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Pill buttons, fields, the edition cover circle, and the half-round ends of slabs.

effects.usage: Risograph grain laid over every page with multiply blending.
